Slides of the Licence 3 course *Mesure et Intégration*, sessions 1–14, academic year 2026–2027. Online reading only. Use the arrow keys or the buttons to move between slides.

[← Back to Teaching](teaching.qmd)

```{=html}
<style>
  #pdfv { max-width: 1000px; margin: 1rem auto; }
  #pdfv .bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; align-items: center;
               justify-content: center; margin-bottom: .6rem; font-size: .95rem; }
  #pdfv button { padding: .25rem .8rem; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: .3rem;
                 background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  #pdfv input { width: 4.5rem; text-align: center; }
  #pdfv .stage { text-align: center; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  #pdfv canvas { max-width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); background: #fff; }
  #pdfv #msg { text-align: center; margin: 1rem 0; }
  @media print { #pdfv { display: none; } }
</style>

<div id="pdfv">
  <div class="bar">
    <button id="first" title="First slide">«</button>
    <button id="prev" title="Previous (←)">‹</button>
    <span>Page <input id="num" type="number" min="1" value="1"> / <span id="count">…</span></span>
    <button id="next" title="Next (→)">›</button>
    <button id="last" title="Last slide">»</button>
    <button id="zout" title="Smaller">−</button>
    <button id="zin" title="Larger">+</button>
  </div>
  <div class="stage"><canvas id="cv"></canvas></div>
  <div id="msg">Loading the slides…</div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var URL_PDF = "files/mesure-integration-L3-slides.pdf";
  var cv = document.getElementById("cv");
  var ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  var msg = document.getElementById("msg");
  var num = document.getElementById("num");
  var count = document.getElementById("count");
  var doc = null, cur = 1, zoom = 1, busy = false, pending = null;

  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc =
    "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js";

  function render(n) {
    if (!doc) return;
    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(doc.numPages, n));
    if (busy) { pending = n; return; }
    busy = true; cur = n; num.value = n;
    doc.getPage(n).then(function (page) {
      var w = Math.min(document.getElementById("pdfv").clientWidth, 1000) * zoom;
      var base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
      var scale = w / base.width;
      var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: scale * dpr });
      cv.width = vp.width; cv.height = vp.height;
      cv.style.width = (vp.width / dpr) + "px";
      return page.render({ canvasContext: ctx, viewport: vp }).promise;
    }).then(function () {
      busy = false;
      if (pending !== null) { var p = pending; pending = null; render(p); }
    }).catch(function () { busy = false; msg.textContent = "Could not display this slide."; });
  }

  function go(d) { render(cur + d); }
  document.getElementById("first").onclick = function () { render(1); };
  document.getElementById("last").onclick = function () { render(doc ? doc.numPages : 1); };
  document.getElementById("prev").onclick = function () { go(-1); };
  document.getElementById("next").onclick = function () { go(1); };
  document.getElementById("zin").onclick = function () { zoom = Math.min(2, zoom + 0.2); render(cur); };
  document.getElementById("zout").onclick = function () { zoom = Math.max(0.4, zoom - 0.2); render(cur); };
  num.onchange = function () { render(parseInt(num.value, 10) || 1); };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.target === num) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "PageDown") { go(1); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "PageUp") { go(-1); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  cv.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () { render(cur); });

  pdfjsLib.getDocument(URL_PDF).promise.then(function (d) {
    doc = d; count.textContent = d.numPages; num.max = d.numPages;
    msg.textContent = ""; render(1);
  }).catch(function () { msg.textContent = "The slides could not be loaded."; });
})();
</script>
```
